title: Here's Everything Apple Did -- and Didn't -- Announce Today
text: Here's Everything Apple Did -- and Didn't -- Announce Today Thursday, 13 September 2018 02:08 Digital - LTE Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) hosted its 2018 iPhone event this morning, unveiling updates to its most important product line. As is often the case, just about everything was widely leaked or rumored heading into the event, although there was one notable curveball.
